dedupe_keys.name: potential of borehole heat exchanger use bavaria germany

description: Technical University of Munich researchers and the Bavarian Environment Agency publish energy-potential data for shallow borehole heat exchangers across Bavaria, Germany. The March 2025 Zenodo deposit supplies one freely downloadable ZIP under CC BY 4.0. It links the agency’s 2024 study of spatially detailed, realisable near-surface geothermal potential for the Bavarian Energy Atlas. These estimates can inform regional heating scenarios and identify areas for more detailed site modelling. They represent assessed potential, not an inventory of installed exchangers or guaranteed energy yields. The public repository summary does not establish spatial resolution, units, exclusions, reference year or internal formats; these remain unknown pending technical-documentation checks. Related catalogue record model-eed-earth-energy-designer concerns borehole design software and does not cover this regional dataset. Resource uncertainty and suitability for individual properties were not independently assessed; the archive was not downloaded.
